label: QC-26B retrospective ZZ-phase fit bound scan (fit circuits only: width-8 depth 1-2 kicked-Ising, target sites 5 and 23); SX offsets fixed at QC-25C values; target MSE before fit 0.014092676627847509
reading: The 0.1 rad solutions are not runaway boundary artifacts: with the bound relaxed to 0.2 and 0.4 the optimum is interior at -0.1012 and +0.1109 rad. Edges 22_23 and 4_5 stay at zero. Phases of about 0.1 rad per CZ are two to five times larger than the 0.022 to 0.047 rad conditional phases QC-26A injected in its synthetic design, so these are effective parameters that may absorb unmodelled physics until QC-26A measures them independently.
